english.title: Accept premature consideration in relation to resale contract
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) accepted consideration from a consumer, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CONSUMER..), in relation to a resale contract, the subject of which was rights under a

(A)_[timeshare]_
(B)_[long-term holiday product]_

contract before the

(C)_[sale of those rights took place]_
(D)_[contract was terminated]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 25(5) and 27 of the Timeshare, Holiday Products, Resale and Exchange Contracts Regulations 2010.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum
Indictment: A fine

Time Limit on Prosecutions;
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
